kdf_iterations.description: Number of PBKDF2 iterations (determines KDF runtime). Typical: 65536 for ~0.5s, 393216 for ~3s (paranoia). Must match actual runtime tuning.

kdf_salt.description: Base64-encoded 160-bit salt used for PBKDF2 (must be exactly 20 bytes raw, 28 chars in base64).

cipher.description: Encryption cipher: 'AES' (128/192/256) or 'Blowfish' (448 max). Must be supported by underlying crypto library.

key_size.description: Key size in bits. Standard mode: 192; Paranoia mode: 256. Must match cipher's supported sizes.

block_size.description: Filesystem block size in bytes. Standard values: 512 (v1.0 default), 1024 (recommended). Larger blocks reduce overhead but increase latency for small writes.

filename_iv_chaining.description: Whether to use per-directory IV chaining for filenames. Enabled by default to prevent filename collision analysis.

per_file_iv.description: Whether to use per-file random initialization vectors. Enabled by default to prevent file-content correlation.

external_iv_chaining.description: Whether to chain per-file IVs using filename IV chaining. Increases security but breaks hardlinks and renames. Default false for standard mode, true for paranoia.

block_mac_headers.description: Whether to enable per-block MAC (Message Authentication Code) headers. Prevents undetected tampering. Default false for standard mode, true for paranoia.

filename_encoding.description: Filename encoding mode: 'stream', 'block', or 'block32'. 'block' recommended for standard; 'stream' for short filenames.

file_holes_pass_through.description: Whether to pass file holes (zero regions) unmodified. Required for SMB compatibility.
